Vintage Story source, decompiled in your browser

How it works

  • The game's code comes from the Linux client archive you open; only its assemblies are kept, in this browser.
  • Decompilation runs entirely in your browser, with ILSpy's decompiler on .NET WebAssembly.
  • No Vintage Story code is hosted or redistributed by this site.
